sessionStart.bash: if command -v pyenv >/dev/null 2>&1; then pyenv exec python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/com.github.copilot/hooks/nstack_config.py" session-start; else python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/com.github.copilot/hooks/nstack_config.py" session-start; fi || true

preToolUse.bash: if command -v pyenv >/dev/null 2>&1; then pyenv exec python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/com.github.copilot/hooks/nstack_config.py" hook; else python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/com.github.copilot/hooks/nstack_config.py" hook; fi || true

postToolUseFailure.bash: if command -v pyenv >/dev/null 2>&1; then pyenv exec python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/com.github.copilot/hooks/nstack_config.py" post-tool-failure; else python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/com.github.copilot/hooks/nstack_config.py" post-tool-failure; fi
